title: Capstone Warmup: Max Gap
prompt: Write max_gap(numbers) returning the largest difference between adjacent values in the list (None for lists with fewer than 2 items).

tests.name: adjacent differences
tests.code:
assert max_gap([4, 9, 10, 20]) == 10, "20 - 10"
assert max_gap([5, 5, 5]) == 0, "all equal -> 0"
assert max_gap([7]) is None and max_gap([]) is None, "too short -> None"
tests.hint: loop from index 1; track the max of numbers[i] - numbers[i-1].
